title: From Zero English to PTE 79 in 12 Weeks
excerpt: How Aman, an IT professional from Pune, went from a 58 to a 79 PTE Academic score in exactly 12 weeks — with a study plan you can copy.
content:
Aman needed PTE 79 for a skilled migration visa. His first attempt scored 58 overall, and he had a hard deadline: the points test closed in three months.

Week 1-2: baseline and diagnosis. He took a full mock test on day one and we scored every section. Speaking fluency was his weakest area, so the plan focused there first.

Week 3-5: speaking block. Aman did 30 minutes of read-aloud drills every morning, recording and scoring himself, then reviewing each recording with a tutor twice a week. His fluency score rose from 54 to 66 in three weeks.

Week 6-8: listening and note-taking. He switched to the highlight-correct-summary tasks and practised the official PTE question bank nightly. Note-taking templates cut his word recall errors by half.

Week 9-11: full mock tests every Saturday, scored by a tutor with a section-by-section feedback report. His scores stabilised between 74 and 78.

Week 12: the real test. Aman scored 79 overall, with 82 in speaking. He booked his visa application the same week.

The takeaway: the PTE is a trainable test. A diagnostic mock, a block-by-block study plan, and weekly scored feedback beat six months of unfocused practice every time.
